{{Top}}
[[File:Holorecorder.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A holorecorder]]
'''Holorecorders''',<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> also known as '''holographic/audio recorder''',<ref name="RPG2E">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> recorded three-dimensional images or [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]]. Holorecorders were capable of storing up to two hundred [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] worth of data in its internal memory, and most units allowed for [[recording rod]]s to be connected to it to serve as expanded memory capacity. Holorecorders weighed about one [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] and from [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] were available for 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="RPG-Core" />

[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] captured much of the proceedings of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] icy defensive trenches with a holorecorder.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Miniaturized holorecorders could be installed inside [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
